name: cf-control
description: Inspect and manage a Cloudflare account, and search/read/research the open internet, through the cf-control-mcp remote MCP server.

interface.shortDescription: Inspect and manage Cloudflare through your private MCP server
interface.longDescription: Use the private cf-control-mcp service to inspect Cloudflare zones, DNS, Workers and KV, and to perform explicitly approved changes such as DNS updates, cache purges and KV writes.
defaultPrompt: List my Cloudflare zones and Workers.
Inspect DNS records without making changes.
Review my Cloudflare configuration and suggest safe changes.
